title: Retire the v1 Host report pipeline and its example ledgers
summary: The compiled platform owns the run ledger and its own projections (assayer_platform.ledger writes platform-ledger.json, and assayer_platform.observability renders platform-observability.json/markdown from it), but the v1 Host report pipeline that derived issues, page-element judgements, run diagnostics, audit summaries, and a performance bill from a v1 audit-ledger.json was still shipped inside the assayer-platform wheel. src/assayer_host/reporting.py defined DerivedReportBuilder, re-exported as a public assayer_host symbol, and src/assayer_host/observability.py defined render_observability and render_performance_bill; neither module had any importer in src/, packages/, plugins/, or scripts/, and no schema loader anywhere referenced audit-ledger.schema.json, so the pair could not run. The only consumers were the module-level exports, tests/test_observability_runtime.py, and four example ledgers under examples/ (minimal, issue, partial, failed) that nothing else read. This change deletes both modules, drops the DerivedReportBuilder export and __all__ entry, deletes the test that exercised only that pipeline, deletes the four orphaned example ledgers, and adds architecture-gate guards so the retired module paths and the DerivedReportBuilder, render_observability, and render_performance_bill symbols cannot return and no shipped Python can reintroduce the retired audit-ledger.json artifact name. docs/verification-and-traceability.md records that the retired example ledgers were replaced by the compiled platform ledger projections. No compiled contract, ledger, result schema, plugin or provider surface, or live Host behaviour changes: the live result path is assayer_platform.ledger plus canonical_result, actionable_result, and result_delivery, which stay untouched. Verification evidence: the change landed in 21a1825, pushed on 2026-09-17 with 21a1825 as the publish point, and CI run 35203824159 passed all seven jobs (Fast and Full on Python 3.11, 3.12, and 3.13, and Install matrix on Python 3.11 and 3.13 including the clean-environment compiled acceptance); locally the architecture check returns 0 on the repository, its ten tests pass including a planted audit-ledger.json literal that is rejected, the fast profile reported 433 tests OK and full reported 446 tests OK, the design confirmation gate passes over the 1fc0ada..21a1825 range, and the document, plugin-source, English text, and resilience gates all returned 0.

platform: Platform governance owns the Host report pipeline, its public exports, and the architecture gate
plugin: No plugin change; ordinary plugins never imported the removed Host modules
provider: No provider change; provider packages use the SDK and platform ledgers that stay in place
agent: No agent change; the retired agent distribution was the only historical caller and is already removed

forbiddenResponsibilities: The change must not alter any compiled contract, platform ledger, or result schema, or any live Host, plugin, or provider behaviour
The change must not remove the live platform projections assayer_platform.ledger, canonical_result, actionable_result, or result_delivery
The change must not reintroduce a v1 audit-ledger.json producer, reader, or the DerivedReportBuilder export
The gate must not reject the live platform symbols build_platform_observability or render_platform_observability
acceptance: src/assayer_host/reporting.py, src/assayer_host/observability.py, and tests/test_observability_runtime.py do not exist
assayer_host exposes no DerivedReportBuilder symbol and no module imports assayer_host.reporting or assayer_host.observability

scripts/check_architecture_boundaries.py rejects a shipped Python file that names audit-ledger.json or reinstates the DerivedReportBuilder, render_observability, or render_performance_bill symbols while the live platform observability symbols stay accepted
the fast and full profiles, the design confirmation gate, and the architecture, document, plugin-source, English text, and resilience gates all stay green, and the compiled acceptance still passes

humanApproval.decision: Release-surface change carried out under the standing authorization of the refactor mandate in #assayer-group:4c84ee19 and its delegation update, under which the agent and reviewer decide these changes themselves within at most seven workflow rounds. The classification is breaking because the assayer-platform wheel stops exporting the DerivedReportBuilder symbol and the assayer_host.reporting and assayer_host.observability modules; the evidence that nothing in the repository consumed them is recorded in the summary. @assayer_rev independently reviews the batch and has previously required that a published-surface removal be classified as a release change.
